title: ITSP.10.171 authenticator issuance, refresh and revocation need lifecycle proof
remediation: The sponsor authenticator custodian documents recipient identity verification, approved initial authenticator settings, distribution, default replacement, lost or damaged handling, compromise reporting, refresh triggers and revocation. Review protective access and sample a sanitized initial issue and a rotation or revocation. Retain no authenticator material. The sponsor confirms the assessed ITSP.10.171 supplementary boundary and accountable owner.

milestones.title: Collect approved authenticator lifecycle settings and redacted issuance, default replacement, refresh or revocation evidence
